cwe.name: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File

involvements.summary: Vendor has provided a patch for the vulnerability.

notes.text: On user login, the Yarbo iOS application writes sensitive authentication data in plaintext to the iOS system log. This data is accessible to any computer the device has previously trusted, using built-in operating system tooling without special access or configuration. An attacker with brief physical access to an unlocked device could harvest these credentials and use them to access the user's registered devices, obtain account identity information, or conduct targeted account-based attacks.
notes.title: Vulnerability Summary

remediations.details: Yarbo recommends users update their app to at least version 3.19.0, which has resolved this vulnerability.
Yarbo recommends users reset previously established trust relationships with paired computers (Settings > General > Transfer or Reset iPhone > Reset > Reset Location & Privacy).
Yarbo urges users to not trust unfamiliar computers when prompted after connecting via USB. Enable a device passcode and keep the device locked when unattended.
